conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5%/month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding exposure to high-quality scanner setups. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a blend of broad market and tactical growth.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretch growth. It utilizes and adds to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, including daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is paramount to manage potential rapid losses.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU, METU, MSFU) to zero to prioritize low drawdown.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. It eliminates leveraged and high-beta holdings, rotating into income-focused ETFs and broad index. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in market downturns.
